files_changed.summary: Plan via 016's planReimport; apply matched updates through the note repository (g1/g2).
Paste panel, counts and Apply control (g3).
5 tests: plan, update, insert, idempotent re-apply, orphan.
3 tests: toggle, counts + apply, disabled when nothing matched.
Mock ReimportReview (its hook needs a live DB).

decisions: 016's planReimport stays the only reader of the identity anchor (RULE-25); the hook introduces no second source and does not guess an anchor.
A matched slug updates the author's note; if the content already equals the paste, nothing is written (re-applying is a no-op), so a repeated import cannot duplicate or churn.
Anchorless sections and orphans are reported but not applied; creating unanchored notes remains 016's recorded follow-up (raised in issues_found).
The control mounts inside the notes rail (026), so it inherits profileId/sessionId from the shared context and needs no feature import.
The picker is a paste textarea, not a file input: the bundle's notes.md is what a user edits and pastes back, and a paste keeps the flow testable and dependency-free.
